summary: Analyzed 4 real NASA SPHEREx observations of RA 321.194433, Dec 24.181670. All images were resampled onto a shared celestial coordinate grid using FITS WCS. The first and last observations contain 2949 pixels above a robust 5-sigma residual threshold within their common coverage. These are candidate image differences, not confirmed astronomical changes. Instrumental noise, point-spread-function differences, calibration and resampling effects may contribute.
limitations: Exploratory WCS-aligned pixel comparison only. No PSF matching, background matching, uncertainty propagation or artifact rejection. Pixel thresholding is not source detection.
